title: Accessing Peekbank Data
text: peekbankr package allows access data peekbank database R. Data hosted versioned peekbank dataset Redivis; get_ functions retrieve tidy tables without write queries. vignette shows examples use data loading functions resulting data look like. several different get_ functions can use extract different types data peekbank: get_datasets() get_subjects() get_administrations() get_trials() get_stimuli() get_aoi_region_sets() get_aoi_timepoints() get_xy_timepoints() Technical note 1: first request open browser window authorize Redivis access (set REDIVIS_API_TOKEN). Technical note 2: Start creating version handle connect_to_peekbank() pass get_ function. handle pins database version whole analysis (“current” resolves latest release); calling get_ functions without one works re-resolves version time warns. Technical note 3: tried optimize time takes get data database (AOI timepoints transfer run-length-encoded expanded locally). query entire timepoint tables, still take , transferring 100s MB data.
code: # load the library library(peekbankr)  # pin a database version for all the calls below con <- connect_to_peekbank()

title: Accessing Peekbank Data
text: get_datasets function returns table related sources dataset, information tracker, information method (e.g., monitor size sample rate). example, can run get_datasets without arguments return datasets database.

title: Accessing Peekbank Data
text: get_subjects function returns information persistent subject identifiers noting subjects participated multiple experiments. includes demographic information (currently sex lab-specific subject id).

title: Accessing Peekbank Data
text: get_administrations function returns information specific experimental administrations subjects database. includes information : age monitor size tracker , run function arguments, get information administrations database, can now also filter dataset name dataset id. age argument takes number indicating age(s) children (months) want analyze. can use argument two ways Pass single number get information participants tested particular age. Pass range ages get information participants tested within certain age range. example, can get participant information children tested ages 24 36 months.
code: d_administrations <- get_administrations(dataset_name = "pomper_saffran_2016", connection = con) head(d_administrations) d_age_range <- get_administrations(age = c(24, 36), connection = con) head(d_age_range)

title: Accessing Peekbank Data
text: get_trials function returns table information trials experiments database. includes following information: Phrase Language Point disambiguation IDs link tables. function also takes dataset name id filters.

title: Accessing Peekbank Data
text: get_stimuli function returns table information stimuli experiments database. includes following information: Label Image Novelty status function also takes dataset name id filters.

title: Accessing Peekbank Data
text: get_aoi_region_sets() returning table information region area interest (AOI) experiments using eye-trackers. includes information dimensions x y, minimum maximum dimension xy spaces. function expected used commonly - information retained part process calculating AOIs XY points.

title: Accessing Peekbank Data
